bullets.text: In Tiruvallur's Bharathiyar Nagar, residents grieve as seawater surges over twenty feet high, flooding homes and streets, and the office should monitor relief efforts.
Passengers fear a Chennai airport shutdown as heavy rains loom and planned stormwater drain work drags on, and the office must watch airport drainage preparations.
PMK MLA Sowmiya Anbumani urges the Tamil Nadu government to issue a notification legally recognizing the Pallikaranai marshland, which the office should review.
People demand the arrest of culprits who damaged ancient temple idols, including the Nandi statue at the Somanathar temple, and the office should track police action.
Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay inspected the Chembarambakkam reservoir amid concerns over the missing link between rain and rainwater storage, which the office should follow.
Tata Communications plans to invest up to $450 million in a 10,000-kilometer India AI Super Highway, and the office should support this digital connectivity initiative.
Researchers from IIIT-H and Ati Robotics demonstrated an AI vision-based robot navigation system ditching LiDAR, and the office should watch local robotics applications.

takeaways: Sea waves exceeding twenty feet breached barriers and flooded homes in Bharathiyar Nagar in Thiruvallur.
Distressed residents are left without shelter as seawater and rainwater inundate residential areas.
